name: grade-3-math
description: See equal groups and fraction pieces.

interface.longDescription: See equal groups and fraction pieces. Includes a launch screen, side-panel workspace, editable input controls and real computations: Build an array; Share with remainders; Shade a fraction. Imports and exports its own versioned documents. Uses supplied information; no live lookup or background monitoring.

positive.description: Open the launch screen without calculating.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the actual launch screen with three distinct workflow cards. No computation or file access.

positive.prompt: Open the Number Steps: Grade 3 Math workspace beside this chat.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the editable workspace and labeled illustrative inputs. No computation starts automatically.

positive.prompt: Help me build an array with these supplied values: {"rows":4,"columns":6}
positive.expected_behavior: Uses grade_3_math_equal_groups with the supplied inputs. Returns {"rows":4,"columns":6,"total":24,"repeated_addition":"6 + 6 + 6 + 6","commuted":"6 × 4"}. Shows the actual array result. Does not fabricate external data.

positive.prompt: Help me share with remainders with these supplied values: {"objects":29,"groups":4}
positive.expected_behavior: Uses grade_3_math_share_equally with the supplied inputs. Returns {"objects":29,"groups":4,"per_group":7,"remainder":1,"check":"4 × 7 + 1 = 29"}. Shows the actual array result. Does not fabricate external data.

positive.prompt: Help me shade a fraction with these supplied values: {"parts":8,"shaded":3}
positive.expected_behavior: Uses grade_3_math_fraction_strip with the supplied inputs. Returns {"parts":8,"shaded":3,"fraction":"3/8","pieces":[true,true,true,false,false,false,false,false]}. Shows the actual fraction result. Does not fabricate external data.
